name: print-social-retail-launch-and-seasonal-banner-system-target
title: Retail launch and seasonal banner set: Target, Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Holiday, New Year
whatItIs: A long sheet with black tape-style headers dividing five campaign sections, each with three wide banners in royal blue and pale blue: a retailer launch with red basket and bullseye, colour/logo/endcap pages, Black Friday and Cyber Monday with hang-tag titles and 48% badges, Holiday with snow and ornaments, and New Year with gold balloons.
whatItMeans: Organised and festive; one blue-and-red system flexes across every sale moment.
techniques: Head each section with a black label strip.
Use hang-tag shapes for campaign titles.
Swap props by season while keeping layout.

vocabulary.definition: A title in a shape like a price tag.
A black tape-like header naming a group.
A round sticker with a discount.
A set of wide banners sharing structure.
